required_capabilities: Create Wall (×3); Create Room/Zone (×4); Inspect Project (×1)
instruction: An office floor plan is already created: a Group Office and, beside it, an empty strip enclosed by the existing walls. Subdivide the strip by creating interior partition walls across it, giving (from one end to the other): one single office, one single office, one double office, and the leftover space as storage. Each single office must be at least 3400 × 2900 mm, the double office at least 3400 × 3600 mm. Create the matching rooms named 'Single office', 'Single office', 'Double office' and 'Storage'. Leave the Group Office and the existing walls untouched.
